nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Accepts only documented ads_manager.sb/sd/sp operation IDs. Provider methods and paths are derived server-side; mutations require preview followed by confirmation.

action.description: preview (default) or confirm for mutations; ignored for reads.

confirmationToken.description: Single-use token required when action is confirm.

operationId.description: Exact catalog operation ID, for example ads_manager.sp.list_campaigns.

payload.description: Documented fields for the selected operation; required by create/update operations. SP POST /list filters such as campaignIdFilter and stateFilter belong in payload as objects with non-empty include arrays of strings.

queryString.description: Optional operation-specific query string without a leading ?; do not use it for SP POST /list filters.
